bill.title: A resolution recognizing the seriousness of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and expressing support for the designation of September 2025 as "PCOS Awareness Month".
bill.latestActionText: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S6959; text: CR 9/30/2025 S6877)
bill.officialSummary: This resolution expresses support for designating September 2025 as PCOS Awareness Month. Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is caused by a hormone imbalance and can cause symptoms such as infertility, weight gain, excess hair growth, and acne.

This is a measure the Library of Congress labels as a congressional tribute or commemoration. It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

plain.whatItDoes: This is a tribute or a commemoration. It does not change any law.
plain.whoItTouches: Nobody directly — this is a statement, not a rule.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing changes for you. No rule and no payment changes.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
